requirements.desc: Agent.resolve must resolve a plugin command id through the active profile prefix match, then the default profile prefix match, then the generic default provider key when no explicit plugin provider/profile override is supplied.
requirements.note: R1: resolves a plugin command id through the generic default when the active profile has no plugin mapping

requirements.desc: Explicit plugin provider/profile overrides forwarded by createPluginAgentApi must take precedence over active profile, default profile, and generic default fallback.
requirements.note: R2: keeps explicit plugin provider overrides ahead of profile and default fallback

requirements.desc: agent.default bare built-in provider-family values must normalize before ProviderRegistry lookup: "codex" maps to "codex/gpt-5.4" and "claude" maps to "claude/sonnet". Unknown default keys must fail without silently selecting another provider.
requirements.note: R3: maps bare built-in default codex to codex/gpt-5.4

requirements.desc: When Agent.call cannot resolve a provider, the thrown error must include commandId, explicit provider override state, explicit/profile environment selection, active profile name, default key, and a concise reason for the failed lookup.
requirements.note: R4: includes resolution context when no provider can be resolved

requirements.desc: The diagnostic error message must exclude prompt text, system prompt text, provider command arguments, secrets, tokens, and absolute local config paths.
requirements.note: R5: redacts prompt, system prompt, provider args, tokens, and absolute paths from diagnostics

requirements.desc: Existing docs.* and flow.* command resolution precedence must remain unchanged except for the improved unresolved-configuration diagnostic text.
requirements.note: R6: preserves normal command active-profile precedence over default profile fallback

requirements.desc: Regression tests must cover plugin command fallback, active profile without plugin mapping, default profile fallback, plugin-specific provider override precedence, bare built-in provider-family default resolution, unknown default diagnostics, and diagnostic redaction.
requirements.note: R7: exercises the regression guard against unrelated provider fallback

entries.reason: draft.json became invalid JSON because a comma was missing after the final QA considered field.
entries.resolution: Added the missing comma and reran JSON parsing before marking draft-refine done.

entries.reason: Draft gate failed because qa[4] used an invalid category value test-strategy outside the allowed draft QA category enum.
entries.resolution: Changed the category to the allowed follow-up-coverage value and reran the draft gate.

entries.reason: Draft gate could not continue because the flow retry recovery state reports attempts 6 above max 5 after an AI artifact failure.
entries.resolution: Stopped the flow per retry-limit rule; no further automatic recovery command is available for this plan gate phase.

entries.reason: Draft gate re-run used the cached invalid guardrail response after manual retry reset, causing the same invalid failureMode error.
entries.resolution: Made the draft requirements verifiable, removed only the stale gate response from .senti/agent-cache, and will reset gateRetry before rerunning.

entries.reason: Test review found missing fallback branch coverage and a path-redaction assertion that used an unrelated temporary directory.
entries.resolution: Added active-profile, default-profile, claude alias, explicit diagnostic reason, and actual Agent root redaction assertions before rerunning scenario validity and test review.

entries.reason: Second test review found vacuous R7 coverage plus missing profile override and unknown-default regression branches.
entries.resolution: Replaced the R7 no-op with a production fallback assertion and added plugin profile override plus unknown default with another configured provider tests.

entries.reason: Initial patch targeted the main repository relative path while the active flow uses a worktree, so the edit did not apply.
entries.resolution: Reapplied the patch using the absolute path under the active worktree and continued all edits inside the worktree.
